thread:
maria: hey design team — quick ask: we need a compact 1‑slide diagram for next Tuesday's webinar showing tradeoffs between latency and cost per 1k tokens across model families (small, base, large, quantized). target art size 1200x600, export PNG + SVG. must follow brand colors and WCAG contrast. first pass needed by Fri EOD. cc @jasper

jasper: on it. do we have canonical numbers or should i pull averages from infra benchmarks?

olivia: use the 'inference economics' spreadsheet (shared in campaign tracker). also add a dotted line showing the recommended 'sweet spot' for most customers. caption suggestion: 'Balancing latency and cost: choose the right model for production economics.'

maria: spreadsheet is source of truth — grants from eng updated results last week. also annotate typical ranges for Hosted vs Dedicated latencies.

jasper: got it. can someone paste the exact columns/rows i should plot?

olivia: Latency_ms and Cost_per_1k_tokens_usd, plus Model_variant for labels. sample rows below:

```
Model_variant,Latency_ms,Cost_per_1k_tokens_usd
gpt-small,45,0.05
gpt-base,75,0.12
gpt-large,150,0.45
gpt-large-8bit,160,0.23
```

figma-bot: New Figma file created by jasper: https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ/latency-cost-seqflow

jasper: two quick design q's — 1) keep this a clean 2D scatter or add micro iconography for throughput? 2) x-axis linear (ms) or log scale?

maria: keep it simple — linear x-axis. no extra icons, just microlabels. also make sure the design reads well when scaled down to social card (600x300).

sam: brand check — use brand-secondary for the points and brand-primary for the sweet‑spot highlight. avoid gradients. confirm accessible color pairings and include alt text describing the chart.

jasper: noted. deliverables i'll produce: layered SVG (named layers), PNG 1200x600, social crop 600x300, alt text draft. ETA Fri 5pm PT.

olivia: if possible, also export a 3-frame GIF showing the highlight transition for the webinar preview — optional but high impact.

jasper: :thumbsup: i'll try to include the GIF. ping me if numbers or the sweet‑spot shift.

maria: thanks! adding this to the campaign tracker. @jasper please label the figma file with 'webinar-2026-04-latency-cost' and drop the final exports there.
